fees.question: What are the fees?
fees.answer1: Private payments on Loofta Pay carry a flat fee charged to the sender — <bold>10 BPS</bold> of the transfer amount plus a <bold>0.002 SOL</bold> gas fee, both paid in USDC. All fees go directly to MagicBlock’s privacy infrastructure. Loofta takes no cut. The recipient always receives the exact amount requested.
fees.answer2: Compared to other privacy tools on Solana (Umbra, Privacy Cash, Houdini Swap) which charge 0.4%–4.4%+ at small amounts, Loofta’s flat fee is consistently the lowest across all transfer sizes.

privatePayments.question: How do private payments work?
privatePayments.answer: Private payments use MagicBlock’s Private Ephemeral Rollup (PER)—infrastructure built for private visibility instead of a typical fully public transfer. That means observers can’t see the same payment details they usually could on-chain, so your activity is much harder to follow or link together. It’s the option to choose when you care about stronger payment privacy.

sendBeforeAccount.question: Can I send to someone before they have an account?
sendBeforeAccount.answer: Yes. You can send to a Twitter/X username or email. They’ll get a link to sign up and claim the payment. Once they log in with that identity, they can claim the funds.

retrieveWallet.question: How do I retrieve my embedded Loofta Pay wallet?
retrieveWallet.answer1: Open your account menu, go to <bold>Settings</bold>, and use <bold>Export Private Key</bold> to back up your embedded Loofta Pay wallet. You can also view your Solana address there.
retrieveWallet.answer2: If you import or use that wallet <bold>outside</bold> Loofta Pay, the privacy and safety assumptions we design for in-app use may no longer apply, and <bold>your privacy may be compromised</bold>. We strongly recommend keeping activity inside Loofta Pay.
retrieveWallet.answer3: <bold>Do not</bold> share your embedded wallet address with people so they can pay you. Share your <bold>Loofta username</bold> or <bold>email</bold> instead—that is how others should send you funds.
retrieveWallet.answer4: To move money out, use <bold>Withdraw</bold> to send USDC to a <bold>new</bold> Solana wallet you control (free on Solana USDC with sponsored gas)—instead of exposing your embedded address.

burnerWallet.question: What is a burner wallet?
burnerWallet.answer: A burner wallet is a temporary deposit address we generate for your payment. You send funds to this address and Loofta Pay routes them to the recipient. You don’t need to connect a wallet to pay—just send to the deposit address.

morphoVault.question: How does Morpho Vault keep my earnings safe?
morphoVault.answer1: Morpho Vault is the protocol powering yield on your Loofta balance — one of the safest and most audited ways to earn passive income in DeFi.
morphoVault.answer2: Unlike yield products that pile risk on top of risk, Morpho operates with transparent, overcollateralized lending markets. Every position is visible on-chain. No hidden strategies, no locked funds, no opaque fund managers. Your USDC earns through verified lending activity — and you can withdraw at any time.
morphoVault.answer3: Morpho has processed billions of dollars in lending volume with an unblemished security record. When your balance earns, it earns safely.

looftaPoints.question: How do Loofta Points work?
looftaPoints.answer1: Every payment you receive earns you Loofta Points automatically — no opt-in required. Points accumulate in your account and unlock rewards across Loofta’s partner network: discounts on tools and services that creators and freelancers already use.
looftaPoints.answer2: Points scale with usage — the more Loofta Pay is your primary payment layer, the more you earn back. As the partner network grows, so does the value of your points.

apy.question: APY on received amount & auto-compound?
apy.answer: We’re building APY in USD on your received balance, with every claimed payment auto-compounding. Coming soon.

features.item0Body: Your username becomes your payment link. Senders pay from any of 20+ chains — you receive exactly the token you want.
features.item1Body: MagicBlock's Private Ephemeral Rollup routes your payments so amounts and counterparts stay yours alone. No setup.
features.item2Body: Every dollar between payments compounds yield through Morpho vaults. Withdraw anywhere, anytime, as any token.

privacy.body: Private Ephemeral Rollups shield amounts, counterparts, and patterns from public observers. No setup, no new wallet — just a toggle.
privacy.bullet3: One toggle. Works with your existing flow.

earn.body: Every minute between payments, your idle USDC earns yield through audited Morpho vaults. Withdraw instantly — we unwind in the background.

business.body: From paying your contractors in five countries to releasing hackathon prizes with KYC — Loofta handles the messy stuff.
business.bulkBody: Upload a CSV or paste a list. Pay your freelancers, creators, hackathon winners, or an entire payroll — in any mix of currencies they each want to receive.
business.ctaTitle: Running payroll, a DAO, or a grants program?
business.ctaBody: Custom volume pricing, dedicated support, and onboarding help for teams paying 50+ recipients.
business.feature0Body: Queue a payment for next Tuesday. Or the 1st of every month. It leaves on time whether you're online or not.
business.feature1Body: Set it once. Payroll every 1st, retainers every 15th, subscriptions weekly. Pause or edit any time.
business.feature2Body: Require identity verification before a recipient can claim. Perfect for hackathon prizes, grants, or compliance-bound transfers.
business.feature3Body: Send a clean invoice link. Client pays any way they want. You get paid in whatever you want. Reconciliation handled.

zcash.body: Receive, request, swap, and off-ramp Zcash without ever exposing amounts or counterparts. A whole side of oofta, built on shielded ZEC.
zcash.shieldedTitle: Receive ZEC the way Zcash was meant to be used.
zcash.shieldedBody: Every payment to your @username settles into a shielded address. No transparent leg, no metadata leak. We never see the amount.
zcash.bullet1: Sender pays from any chain — they don't need ZEC
zcash.bullet2: We swap on the way in, deposit shielded
zcash.tile0Body: Hand someone your @username, they pay in shielded ZEC. No exchange account, no KYC bridge, no leak.
zcash.tile1Body: Convert ZEC to USD, EUR, or your local bank — without the on-chain trail. Funds land in Revolut, Wise, or any account.
zcash.tile2Body: One link. Set the amount, share it anywhere. The sender pays from any chain — you receive shielded ZEC.
zcash.tile3Body: ZEC ↔ USDC, SOL, ETH, USDT. Best route across NEAR Intents and on-chain DEXs. Settles in seconds.

builtOn.body: Every payment settles on Solana in under half a second. MagicBlock's Private Ephemeral Rollup keeps amounts and counterparts off the public ledger — by default, for every user, every time.

cta.body: Free account. No seed phrase. No wallet install. Ready in 30 seconds.
